name: SLOWSHED-floor
old: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN || ms / statements < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;
new: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN - 1 || ms / statements < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;
note: one request fewer than the floor opens the shed

name: SLOWSHED-threshold-side
note: a database exactly at the threshold not shed

name: SLOWSHED-span
note: slow requests long gone keep the shed opening

name: SLOWSHED-unweighted
old: for (const w of slowWaits) { waited += w.ms; asked += w.n; }
new: for (const w of slowWaits) { waited += w.ms / w.n; asked += 1; }
note: the mean a request's, not a statement's - a hundred quick statements read as slow

name: SLOWSHED-quick-keeps-open
old: if (slowWaits.length < SLOW_SHED_MIN || ms / statements < SLOW_SHED_WAIT_MS) return;
note: a quick request keeps the shed open past the drain

name: SLOWSHED-nothing-counted
note: a shed read (no statement) counted as a quick request

name: SLOWSHED-wait-unheard
old: noteD1Wait(tally.ms, tally.n, Date.now());   // SLOW-SHED: the isolate's shed hears how long the database made it wait
note: the service never hears its own wait

name: SLOWSHED-client-timeout-unheard
note: a display read that timed out asked again at once

name: SLOWSHED-client-any-read
note: an act that timed out holds the reads

name: SLOWSHED-client-unreachable
note: the player's own dropped line holds the reads

name: SLOWSHED-client-no-doubling
note: timeouts in a row never wait longer
